rows: Overlaps the execution of different layers for the same input by streaming intermediate outputs directly from one hardware stage to the next without writing back to memory.
Unrolls and pipelines operations within a single layer (e.g., convolutions across pixels/channels) so that each new computation begins every clock cycle (II = 1).
Combines multiple operations like conv + BN + ReLU into a single hardware block, reducing memory usage and latency between layers.
